common: Seamless tileable texture swatch for a stylized cel-shaded 3D game. The surface fills the entire square image edge to edge, seen perfectly flat and straight-on (orthographic), no perspective, no lighting, no shadows, no vignette, no border, no frame, no objects. Style: flat-colored anime background painting: flat base color fills, pattern drawn with thin hand-drawn warm-dark ink lines, a few sparse ink dots or short hatching strokes, muted low-saturation colors, no photographic detail, no noise, no gradients, even brightness everywhere. The pattern continues seamlessly past all four edges. No text, no letters, no logos.

items.name: M_Poster_Atlas
items.prompt: A flat graphic design sheet: a grid of exactly 4 columns and 2 rows of eight separate vertical poster panels on a pure white background, each panel a tall rectangle (1:2) with wide empty white gutters between all panels and around the edge, nothing crossing the gutters. The eight panels, left to right then top row then bottom row: 1) a fight event poster: dark navy background, two silhouetted fighters facing each other in orange-red backlight, a thin octagon outline in gold; 2) a second fight event poster: deep red background with a black octagon shape and a single fighter silhouette throwing a kick, gold accent bars; 3) a gym rules board: cream background with six horizontal rows, each row a small dark pictogram circle on the left (a shoe, a drop of water, a clock, a glove, a bow, a heart) and a blank grey bar on the right; 4) a weight class chart: pale grey background with eight horizontal striped bars alternating dark grey and off-white, a small scale pictogram at the top; 5) an old vintage fight poster: faded sepia paper background, a single fighter silhouette in a victory pose with arms raised in a spotlight, a worn border, no faces; 6) a wall plaque with a championship belt: a dark wood plaque panel holding a black leather belt with a large round ornate metal plate in brushed gold with abstract laurel pattern and two smaller side plates, no lettering; 7) a plain sign panel: flat grey-green background with a single white rounded rectangle; 8) a vertical banner: flat dark red background with a thin cream border line and a cream brush-stroke shape in the middle. Style: flat-colored anime poster illustration, flat fills, thin ink lines, muted low-saturation colors, no gradients, no photographic detail. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no readable words anywhere, no faces.
